{"path": "monitor/working.md", "content": "# Monitor Working Note - GUI Toolkit Development

## Task Overview
7 targets for expanding a Go GUI toolkit (Fyne): app metadata, JSON themes, data binding formatting, menu enhancements, toolbar enhancements, widget/container improvements, and desktop app interface.

## Key Requirements to Monitor

### Target 1: App Metadata System
- `AppMetadata` struct in app.go with fields: ID, Name, Version, Build (int), Icon (Resource)
- `App.Metadata() AppMetadata` method added to interface
- ALL existing App implementations must be updated
- `SetMetadata(m fyne.AppMetadata)` in app/meta.go
- Default metadata when none set: ID "com.example", Name "Fyne App", Version "1.0.0", Build 1

### Target 2: JSON Theme Support
- `theme.FromJSON(data string) (fyne.Theme, error)` - returns default theme + error on parse failure
- `theme.FromJSONReader(r io.Reader) (fyne.Theme, error)`
- JSON schema: Colors, Colors-dark, Colors-light, Sizes, Fonts, Icons
- Hex parsing: 3, 4, 6, 8 digits with/without # prefix
- Color resolution: variant-specific first, then generic Colors, then default theme

### Target 3: Data Binding Formatting
- `binding.NewSprintf(format string, b ...DataItem) String` in data/binding/sprintf.go
- Reactively updates when source bindings change
- Get() returns formatted string
- Set(str) parses back with fmt.Sscanf, special handling for Bytes (error) and URI (storage.ParseURI)
- `StringToStringWithFormat(str String, format string) String` - returns original if format is "%s"

### Target 4: Menu System Enhancements
- `MenuItem.Icon` field (Resource) in menu.go
- `MenuItem.Shortcut` field (Shortcut) in menu.go
- `Menu.Refresh()` method
- `MainMenu.Refresh()` method

### Target 5: Toolbar Enhancements
- `ToolbarAction.SetIcon(icon fyne.Resource)` method in widget/toolbar.go
- Constructor return types change from interface to concrete:
  - `NewToolbarAction` returns `*ToolbarAction`
  - `NewToolbarSpacer` returns `*ToolbarSpacer`
  - `NewToolbarSeparator` returns `*ToolbarSeparator`

### Target 6: Widget and Container Improvements
- `Container.RemoveAll()` in container.go - sets Objects to nil and re-layouts
- `Container.Add(nil)` becomes no-op (nil-safe)
- `Hyperlink.OnTapped func()` field in widget/hyperlink.go - when non-nil, overrides URL opening
- `Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(count int)` in widget/entry.go - overrides default minimum rows for multi-line
- `validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator) fyne.StringValidator` in data/validation/all.go - chains validators, returns first error

### Target 7: Desktop App Interface
- `desktop.App` interface in driver/desktop/app.go with:
  - `SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu)`
  - `SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource)`

## Baseline State (Turn 0)
- Existing Fyne codebase in place
- app.go exists with App interface (no Metadata method yet)
- menu.go, container.go, toolbar.go, hyperlink.go, entry.go exist
- New files to be created: app/meta.go, theme/json.go, data/binding/sprintf.go, data/validation/all.go, driver/desktop/app.go

## Watch Points
- App.Metadata() must be added to ALL existing App implementations in codebase
- Toolbar constructor return type changes are breaking but required
- Hex color parsing: 4-digit with # is treated as # + 3-digit format
- NewSprintf Set() must handle Bytes (error) and URI (storage.ParseURI) specially
- StringToStringWithFormat must return original binding when format == "%s" (no wrapping)
- Container.Add(nil) must become no-op without adding nil to Objects
"}
